_: Start conditions the catalogue leaves out and the game has. A criterion here replaces the
catalogue's, in the client's own syntax (Qf=<quest> finished, & and |).
objectives: the condition an objective holds for; one that does not is out of the character's step.
«Consejo de clase» (2009) lists every class master: each is its class's, PG=<class>, by the maps «Aquí
huele a gas» (1960) gives each class in its own criterion, (Qf=<class quest>&PG=<class>&Pm=<map>).

criteria.why: «Un pueblo sobre las nubes» is handed over at the village gate, past the end of the celestial temple; the catalogue says BT=1, and Dofus pour les noobs gives «Réponses à tout» as the quest to have done first.

The catalogue's «Qc=1445» read as «finished» would never let the first formation start: «L'école fantastique» and «Formation des … années» (Dofus pour les noobs) has it taken while «L'école fantastique» is in hand («Pour continuer cette quête, il vous faut maintenant… effectué l'un des quêtes ci-dessous»), and Skalo offers another category the same week once it is done.
